density.label: Information density
density.compactHelp: Tight rows — fits more on screen
density.spaciousHelp: Roomy — easier to read at distance
density.help: Affects table rows, cards, and dashboard widgets across the app.

statusBar.label: Status bar
statusBar.showHelp: Always-on footer with connection health, live freshness, priority alerts, recent pages, and operational activity.
statusBar.iconOnlyHelp: Hide labels at all widths. Lower-priority tools move into more on constrained screens.

timeFormat.label: Default time format
timeFormat.absoluteHelp: Best for trip planning and event correlation
timeFormat.help: Hover any timestamp to see the alternate format. Override per-surface with the format prop where needed.

chartPalette.label: Chart palette
chartPalette.help: Defaults to the Okabe-Ito palette so series remain distinguishable for the ~8% of users with red-green colour vision deficiency.
chartPalette.cbSafeHelp: Okabe-Ito palette — distinguishable for all CVD types.
chartPalette.neonHelp: The same calm palette in a violet-led order.

appDesignPreview.disclosure: Synthetic sandbox. All readings, journeys and locations below are examples, not your vehicle data. Interactions stay here; nothing is saved and no commands are sent.
appDesignPreview.workspace: Explore a complete sample workspace, including open controls and recovery states.
appDesignPreview.activitySummary: Five sample journeys are complete; one has an unavailable energy reading. Unknown is never shown as zero.
appDesignPreview.reviewSummary: Review the partial journey before comparing totals. These examples do not describe the health of your vehicle.
appDesignPreview.overviewSummary: A useful overview keeps totals, source quality and the next review step together.
appDesignPreview.loadedOnly: Six local examples, not a fleet total
appDesignPreview.partialTotal: Total withheld: one journey is partial
appDesignPreview.coverageDetail: Five of six energy readings are available
appDesignPreview.gapDetail: Missing observations remain a gap in the chart.
appDesignPreview.arrivedDetail: Review the journey alongside its source quality.
appDesignPreview.formHelp: Try validation, keyboard focus and selection. Apply updates this sandbox only and is discarded when it closes.
appDesignPreview.nameRequired: Enter a name for this local example.
appDesignPreview.nameHint: This name is not saved to your account.
appDesignPreview.tableHelp: Sort columns, search these six loaded rows, filter source quality and change pages. A dash means unknown; zero remains zero.
appDesignPreview.chartHelp: A real SVG plot with a deliberate observation gap. Hover for values; use the legend to hide a series.
appDesignPreview.mapHelp: Local vector fixture at fictional ocean coordinates. No basemap or location service is requested. Pan, zoom and open a marker.
appDesignPreview.stopHelp: Example marker, not a recorded vehicle position.
appDesignPreview.emptyState: No sample alerts in this view.
appDesignPreview.staleState: Last sample observation: 12 minutes ago. Cached readings stay visible, but are not live.
appDesignPreview.partialState: Five energy readings are available; one is unknown. The total is withheld.
appDesignPreview.retainedHelp: The previous readings stay visible. A failed refresh does not erase measured zero or turn an unknown reading into zero.
appDesignPreview.retainedRecoveredHelp: The local refresh completed; the same retained readings remain available.
appDesignPreview.recoveredHelp: Local retry succeeded. No server request was made.
appDesignPreview.errorState: Synthetic source unavailable. Retry to demonstrate local recovery.
appDesignPreview.tooltip: Every action here is local to this synthetic preview.
appDesignPreview.popoverHelp: Explore open, selected and focus states without changing the saved design.
appDesignPreview.dialogSummaryText: Harbor loop is a synthetic journey with a real plotted trace and local map geometry.
appDesignPreview.dialogQualityText: The trace includes an observation gap. Missing values are not interpolated into verified readings.

widgetDesignPacks.saved: {{name}} saved across machines on this server.
widgetDesignPacks.title: App design packs
widgetDesignPacks.appPreviewHelp: Shared navigation, headings, controls and panels use this design when applied to the entire application.
widgetDesignPacks.appScopeHelp: Entire application styles navigation, panels, controls, tables and dialogs with the same pack. Color mode, accent, fonts, density and accessibility preferences stay unchanged. This choice also syncs across machines.
widgetDesignPacks.scope: Saved on this TeslaSync server for your verified external-provider identity and restored on other machines. Deployments without login share one server selection. Other appearance settings and saved layouts stay unchanged.
widgetDesignPacks.verifying: Verifying your identity and loading the saved selection...
widgetDesignPacks.saveError: Your last confirmed selection remains visible. Check your server connection and external-provider session, then retry.
widgetDesignPacks.noMatchingPacks: No packs match these style and intensity filters.
widgetDesignPacks.synthetic: Synthetic examples only. Preview does not connect to a vehicle, change preferences or send commands.
widgetDesignPacks.previewError: The preview could not load. Retry, or close the preview without changing your selection.
